world.title: US energy department engineer held for alleged Houthi links, drone and explosives support
world.summary: A US Department of Energy electrical engineer, Ellaboudy, was arrested for allegedly providing material support to the Iran-backed Houthi rebels. He traveled to Yemen in September 2022, intending to assist the Houthis in enhancing their communications capabilities. Investigators revealed he informed FBI informants about needing to be smuggled into and out of Yemen during his activities.

world.title: Araghchi said Iran would allow access to nuclear inspectors for sanctions relief
world.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi announced that Iran would permit access to nuclear inspectors at bombed facilities in exchange for sanctions relief. This statement, reported by Bloomberg, reflects the country's significant economic challenges, although Araghchi did not directly address the state of Iran's economy. The proposal indicates a potential shift in Iran's approach to international negotiations.

world.title: Putin Kaliningrad nuclear warning: Russia would use all weapons if attacked
world.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin warned that Russia would utilize all available weapons, including nuclear options, if Kaliningrad or any other territory faced direct attack. This statement, made during the Valdai Forum in Moscow, comes amid rising tensions related to Ukraine. NATO responded, stating that such nuclear threats are unhelpful and exacerbate the current situation.

business.title: Venu, Vijay Singh query Noel's merger plan to avoid Tata Sons IPO
business.summary: Tata Trusts vice-chairmen Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh have raised concerns regarding chairman Noel Tata's plan to merge two Tata Sons subsidiaries. This move aims to circumvent an initial public offering (IPO) for Tata Sons. Additionally, the Reserve Bank of India recently rejected Tata Sons' deregistration application, mandating compliance with regulations for non-banking finance companies in the upper layer category.

business.title: Gold holds firm despite elevated yields as Fed bets soften - Kitco PM Report
business.summary: Spot gold and silver prices rose in late U.S. trading, supported by easing Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations. Gold traded near $4,159.11 an ounce, up 0.10%, while silver was at $60.980, up 0.18%. North American equities finished higher, recovering from early losses, while European markets declined due to rising global bond yields. Jobless claims fell, indicating labor market resilience.

business.title: Anup Saha and Anup Bagchi: ICICI, IIT, IIM and more - What's common between two big banks bosses of HDFC and Kotak
business.summary: Anup Kumar Saha and Anup Bagchi, leaders of HDFC and Kotak banks, share notable backgrounds. Both have previously worked at ICICI Bank and are graduates of prestigious institutions, IIT and IIM. Their careers reflect a strong foundation in finance and management, contributing to their current roles in leading major banking institutions in India.

technology.title: OnePlus 16’s 9,000mAh Battery Is Now Officially Confirmed
technology.summary: The OnePlus 16's battery capacity has been officially confirmed at 9,000mAh by OnePlus executive Li Jie Louis. This marks an increase of 1,700mAh compared to the OnePlus 15. The announcement comes ahead of the device's launch in China, scheduled for October 12. Previously, the battery capacity had been speculated through leaks reported by various sources.

technology.title: Windows 11 26H2 is now available
technology.summary: Microsoft has released Windows 11 version 26H2, known as the Windows 11 2026 Update, starting September 29. This update is available for eligible PCs currently running Windows 11 versions 24H2 or 25H2. Users of these versions will only need to perform one restart to complete the update process, as it is delivered as a small enablement package.

technology.title: Samsung still testing Exynos 2700 for the Galaxy S27 Ultra
technology.summary: Samsung is currently testing a prototype of the Galaxy S27 Ultra that appears to feature the Exynos 2700 processor. This development suggests that the device may not be limited to Snapdragon chips only. The testing phase indicates Samsung's ongoing commitment to its in-house Exynos line, potentially offering consumers more options for the upcoming flagship smartphone.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026 Live Updates Day 14: India wins first-ever gold in women's team recurve archery; wrestling, sepaktakraw and golf results
sports.summary: India secured its first-ever gold medal in women's team recurve archery at the 2026 Asian Games. Live updates from Day 14 include results from wrestling, sepaktakraw, and golf. Notable moments include Dipanshi attempting to draw inspiration from Vinesh Phogat's upset at the Paris Olympics while facing Japanese wrestler Susaki, who scored points during their match.

sports.title: Know India scores, updates and results from Day 13
sports.summary: On Day 13 of the Asian Games 2026, India focused on hockey, archery, boxing, and wrestling. Kashish Malik advanced to the mixed virtual taekwondo quarter-finals after defeating Hong Kong's Lam Siu Wei 2-0. She is now one victory away from winning a medal. Updates on scores, results, and medal winners were provided throughout the day.

sports.title: prediction, team news, lineups
sports.summary: Brazil will face India in their first-ever meeting during an international friendly at Kolkata's Salt Lake Stadium on Saturday. The Brazilian team arrives after consecutive victories against Australia, while India recently drew with Panama. The match is anticipated to showcase both teams' strategies and player lineups, as they prepare for this significant encounter in international football.

health.title: Temperament, childhood adversity may offer clues to psychiatric vulnerability: NIMHANS study
health.summary: A study by NIMHANS suggests that temperament and childhood adversity may indicate vulnerability to psychiatric disorders. Researchers found that shared family traits across various disorders and specific risk patterns could be identified. The findings, published in the Journal of Affective Disorders, highlight the importance of understanding these factors in assessing psychiatric risks and developing preventive strategies for mental health issues.

health.title: Breast Cancer Awareness Month: Doctors share 5 health tips for working women to reduce risk
health.summary: October marks Breast Cancer Awareness Month, focusing on education about breast health, early detection, and support for affected individuals. Doctors emphasize five health tips specifically for working women to help reduce their risk of breast cancer. The initiative aims to raise awareness and encourage proactive measures among women to prioritize their health during this important month.

health.title: Vaping may harm heart health too, not just lungs, doctors warn
health.summary: Doctors warn that vaping, often associated with lung health, may also negatively impact heart health. Nicotine in e-cigarettes can elevate heart rate and blood pressure while constricting blood vessels. The long-term cardiovascular effects of vaping are still under investigation, highlighting the need for awareness, especially among young people regarding the potential risks to their heart and vascular health.

science.title: Why You Really Say “Achoo”: The Surprising Reason Behind Every Sneeze
science.source: Futura, le média qui explore le monde
science.summary: Sneezing, represented by various sounds in different languages, follows a universal biological mechanism. This reflex action is triggered by irritants in the nasal passages, leading to a forceful expulsion of air. Despite cultural variations in spelling the sound, the underlying process remains consistent globally. Sneezing serves as a common bodily response that many people take for granted.

science.title: Astronomers spot giant bow shock around magnetic white dwarf 730 light-years away, revealing mysterious outflow lasting over 1000 years
science.summary: Astronomers using the European Southern Observatory's Very Large Telescope have captured images of a giant bow shock surrounding a magnetic white dwarf located 730 light-years away. This shock wave, which has persisted for over 1,000 years, cannot be explained by known astrophysical mechanisms. The findings contribute to the understanding of stellar remnants and their interactions with surrounding material.

science.title: How sugar from outer space may have helped build life on Earth; study finds ribose kept boron dissolved in early waters
science.summary: A study suggests that ribose, a simple sugar delivered to early Earth by meteorites, may have significantly contributed to the emergence of life. Researchers found that ribose helped keep boron dissolved in primordial waters, which could have been crucial for biochemical processes. This discovery indicates that the role of extraterrestrial sugars in life's origins is more complex than previously understood.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: October 2, 2026
entertainment.summary: On October 2, 2026, Taurus may experience a shift towards a more hopeful future, bringing a sense of positivity. However, feelings of mental exhaustion persist, creating a contrast between hope and fatigue. This duality may lead to introspection as Taurus navigates current challenges while recognizing the potential for improvement in their circumstances.

entertainment.title: Cancer Horoscope Today: October 2, 2026
entertainment.summary: Cancer horoscope for October 2, 2026, suggests a need for reflection on personal purpose. Individuals may feel trapped or disconnected from their original goals. There is an indication of something significant being offered or held onto, yet past emotional wounds may still influence current feelings. The horoscope encourages self-examination to navigate these challenges effectively.

entertainment.title: Capricorn Horoscope Today: October 2, 2026
entertainment.summary: Today, Capricorns are advised to reassess their nurturing roles, which may have become burdensome over time. What once brought joy may now feel overwhelming, suggesting a need for balance and self-care. It’s important to recognize the weight of responsibilities and consider taking a step back to alleviate stress. Prioritizing personal well-being is essential for maintaining harmony in life.
